g.text: Independent streams let replies progress during the next dispatch
8 H100s · hybrid · one BF16 MoE layer. Shown: Attention GPU A2; mixed, requests 20–23. Kernel intervals include waits.
Orange is a reply copy; grey is other collect work. No continuous network-traffic claim. Input staging/output assembly are outside these ranges.
